question: Under which scheme, Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha inaugurated "UMEED Market Place" in Jammu and Kashmir?

options.text: AVSAR Scheme of Airport Authority of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**AVSAR Scheme of Airport Authority of India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ​The** "AVSAR" initiative **was started by the** Airport Authority of India (AAI).**
 
• Its aim is to support and give chances to** women, artisans, and craftspeople.**
